title: Settlement account
subtitle: What a branch owes back (shortage · عجز) or may keep (surplus · فائض), and what a till has already taken against it.

access.deniedHint: Your account does not hold the grant for the settlement account. Ask an administrator if you need it.
access.unreachableHint: Your access could not be checked, so this screen stays closed. Try again in a moment.

search.label: Find a branch or an entry
search.placeholder: Branch code, name in either script, city, or entry #
search.empty: No branch matches that. Try a code, part of a name in either script, or a city.

errors.fleetFailed: The estate could not be loaded, so search and the ageing count are unavailable.
errors.worklistFailed: The worklist could not be loaded.

worklist.title: What needs a human
worklist.estateWide: Wrong money and waiting cash are shown for the whole estate, whichever branches are scoped.
worklist.nothing: Nothing needs a human right now. No consumption is missing its document and no prepared receipt is waiting.

wrongMoney.title: Wrong money ({{count}})
wrongMoney.hint: A till took money against an entry and the document behind it never arrived.
wrongMoney.row: consumed {{at}}, with no document behind it

repair.title: Repair this consumption
repair.summary: Put {{amount}} back onto its entry at branch {{store}}.
repair.raceHint: If a document has arrived since this list was drawn, the repair does nothing at all — which is the right outcome, and you will be told.
repair.reasonHint: Up to 200 characters. This is kept beside the repair in the branch's history.
repair.done: {{amount}} is back on the entry at {{store}}.
repair.noOp: A document arrived for this consumption — nothing to repair.
repair.refused: The server would not repair this consumption.
repair.failed: The repair could not be sent.

account.empty: No settlement entry has ever been posted against this branch. That is the ordinary state for most of the estate, not a failed lookup.
account.capReached: This account came back with {{limit}} entries, which is the most the server will send. There may be more that are not shown here.

errors.loadFailed: This branch's account could not be loaded.

headline.notActionable: The position is shown, never settled. A till consumes one entry, of one kind, through one document — a shortage and a surplus never cancel each other out.

journal.title: What a till has taken against this entry
journal.noSelection: Pick an entry above to read its journal.
journal.empty: No till has taken anything against this entry yet.
journal.emptyCancelled: Nothing was ever taken against this entry — which is why it could be cancelled outright rather than written off.
journal.writtenOff: {{amount}} of the remainder was written off by {{by}} on {{at}}. The journal below is unchanged by that — a write-off touches no consumption.

document.orphan: No document — the close never completed
document.orphanHint: The receipt number is stamped on after the fact, so a blank one means the close is either seconds old or it timed out and gave up. If it stays blank, this is money the branch handed over against a document that will never exist.

correction.title: Correcting a mistake
correction.noAmend: Changing the amount is not offered at all. Once posted, an entry is either withdrawn whole while nothing has been taken against it, or its remainder written off once a till has taken part of it.
correction.journalUntouched: Neither act touches what a till has already taken — the journal below is unchanged by a write-off, and a receipt already in a collector's hands is never retro-voided.
correction.reasonHint: Up to {{max}} characters. It is kept beside the correction in this branch's history, and read by whoever asks about this entry months from now.
correction.dismiss: Read it — show me what I can do

cancel.why: Nothing has been taken against entry {{number}}, so all {{amount}} of it can be withdrawn as though it never happened.

writeOff.why: A till has already taken part of entry {{number}} — {{remaining}} of {{amount}} is left. It cannot be cancelled, because what a till took is on a document the branch already acted on. The remainder can be written off instead.

none.consumed: A till has taken all of this entry. There is nothing left to cancel or write off — it is finished, and its journal below says where the money went.
none.cancelled: This entry was cancelled. Nothing had been taken against it, so it was withdrawn as though it never happened, and it is not corrected twice.
none.written-off: This entry's remainder was already written off. What a till took before that is unchanged, and an entry is not corrected twice.
none.nothing-left: This entry has nothing left on it, so there is nothing to cancel or to write off.

raced.partlyConsumed: A till consumed part of this entry while this was open — {{remaining}} is left, not {{amount}}. It can no longer be cancelled as though it never happened. Write off the rest instead?
raced.nothingLeft: A till consumed all of entry {{number}} while this was open. There is nothing left to cancel or to write off — the entry is finished, and the journal below shows what took it.
raced.refused: The server would not cancel this entry, and its remaining has not changed. Read the journal below before deciding what to do next.
raced.closeOutRefused: The remainder was not written off. The server says {{remaining}} is what this entry now has left — read the journal below before deciding what to do next.
raced.closeOutUnstated: The remainder was not written off, and the server did not say what this entry now has left. Read the journal below before deciding what to do next.

done.writtenOff: Entry {{number}}'s remainder is written off. What a till already took is unchanged.

errors.cancelFailed: The cancellation could not be sent.
errors.closeOutFailed: The write-off could not be sent.

audit.title: Everything that has happened to this entry
audit.localTime: Times are the branch's own local clock, as the server wrote them — nothing on this pane is converted, and nothing is read from the administration audit, whose times are UTC.

post.openForBranch: Post an entry on this branch
post.title: Post a settlement entry

SHORTAGE.consequence: The branch must hand this money over

SURPLUS.consequence: The branch may keep this money back

branch.label: Which branch
branch.placeholder: Code, name in either script, or city — e.g. 0142, الروضة, Al-Rawdah, Riyadh
branch.unavailable: The estate could not be loaded, so no branch can be resolved and nothing can be posted. Try again in a moment.
branch.ambiguous: {{count}} branches match that. Nothing can be posted until exactly one does — pick one, or type the branch code.
branch.none: No branch matches that. Nothing can be posted until exactly one does.

standing.loading: Reading what this branch already carries…
standing.unknown: This branch's account could not be read, so what it already carries is unknown. Open the account before you commit.
standing.capped: This branch's account came back at the server's row limit, so what it already carries cannot be read in full here. Open the account before you commit.

clear.SHORTAGE: This branch carries no open shortage today.
clear.SURPLUS: This branch carries no open surplus today.

warning.SHORTAGE_one: This branch already owes {{total}} on an open shortage.
warning.SHORTAGE_other: This branch already owes {{total}} across {{count}} open shortages.
warning.SURPLUS_one: This branch may already keep back {{total}} on an open surplus.
warning.SURPLUS_other: This branch may already keep back {{total}} across {{count}} open surpluses.

standing.permitted: Posting another is allowed, and sometimes right — a genuine second one months later is a real entry. Check only that this is not the same one twice.

amount.label: Amount
amount.hint: Type an amount greater than zero. A grouping comma is fine.
amount.tooSmall: That figure rounds to nothing the ledger can hold, so no till could take it or hand it over.
amount.needsBranch: Name a branch first — the amount is counted in that branch's own currency.

reason.label: Why (the branch reads this at the till)
reason.hint: {{used}} of {{max}} characters. It is kept with the entry and read verbatim by the branch.
reason.previewEmpty: Nothing yet — a branch manager reading this at 23:00 has only these words to go on.

review.immutable: Once posted, this amount cannot be changed. It can only be cancelled while nothing has been taken against it, or its remainder written off once a till has taken part of it.

done.adjusted: The server stored {{stored}} {{currency}}, not the {{reviewed}} that was reviewed. The figure above is the one on the ledger and the one the branch will be asked for.
done.immutable: Quote this number to the branch. The amount cannot be changed from here — it can only be cancelled while untouched, or its remainder written off once a till has taken part of it.

errors.failed: The entry could not be posted.

kind.legend: What every row in this file does
kind.oneKindPerFile: One kind per file. The sheet has no kind column — a file mixing the two would make the total below a net figure a typo could hide inside.

file.label: The sheet finance produced
file.hint: An .xlsx or a .csv. Columns are read by their names, so a re-ordered sheet still posts.
file.reading: Sending the file and reading it back…
file.serverParses: Nothing is read here — the file goes up as it is and every figure below comes back from the server's own reading of it.

review.blocked: Nothing in this file can be posted until {{count}} of these are fixed in the sheet. Fix them, save, and upload it again.
review.unresolved: Row {{row}} — no branch has the code {{code}}, so this row cannot be posted onto anything.
review.warned: {{count}} rows carry a warning. They post: a branch that already carries an open entry of this kind can genuinely owe a second one, and this door is never stricter than the single form.
review.disagree: The server's own total for this file is {{server}}, and the rows below add up to {{rows}}. The rows are what will be posted. Read both before committing.
review.noCurrency: {{count}} of these rows came back without a currency, so the figure above is read at two decimals. Open one of those branches before committing.
review.totalHint: The figure above is the sum of the {{count}} rows in the grid — read the sentence, not the digits.
review.refusedHint: The file on disk is not the one that was previewed. Preview it again to see what changed before anything is posted.

done.replayed: This exact file had already been committed, so nothing was doubled — these are the entries it posted the first time.
done.immutable: These amounts cannot be changed. Each can be cancelled while nothing has been taken against it, or its remainder written off once a till has taken part of it — and the whole batch can be withdrawn as one act.

errors.previewFailed: The file could not be read.
errors.commitRefused: This file was not posted. It no longer matches the one that was previewed.
errors.commitFailed: This file was not posted, and the server did not say why. Preview it again before trying anything else.

errors.withdrawFailed: The batch could not be withdrawn.

act.notRetroVoided: What a till has already taken is untouched by this: a receipt in a collector's hands is never retro-voided, and an entry a till reached first keeps its remainder until someone writes it off on its own account.
act.reasonLabel: Why (every withdrawn entry's audit reads this)
act.reasonHint: Up to {{max}} characters. It is filed against each entry this act withdraws — "finance sent the wrong file" is the sentence this box is for.
act.wholeBatch: Withdraw every entry this batch posted. Entries a till has already spent are refused and named.

outcome.refused: A till got to these first ({{count}})
outcome.refusedRow: Not withdrawn — {{remaining}} is what it now has left. {{reason}}
outcome.refusedRowUnstated: Not withdrawn — {{remaining}} is what it now has left, and the server did not say why.

figures.notActionable: A report figure. Nobody owes the estate's total and no till can consume it — a position belongs to one branch, on its own account.
